summary: 97/37 attests mparpso under prps, not the quoted mpalšo

data.question: Should 97/37 be removed as support for mpalšo? Verify the independent grammar-page reference 172 before deciding whether to retain the example.

rationale: The supplied full verse 97/37 reads "i gamiyaṯe mparpso". It contains no mpalšo. The same clause is quoted accurately under prps.I.d.preterit.1 in this batch. The difference changes root consonants and is not normalization. No replacement citation for mpalšo is supplied, and grammar page 172 is not available here, so the correct final disposition cannot be settled from this evidence.
